responses.explanation: The claim that trade value fell by 55.97% and volume by 61.42% does not negate the structural vulnerabilities in the supply chain. Document ORV-0024 confirms that Orvan grows more wheat and maize than it consumes, indicating a reliance on exports that can be disrupted. Additionally, ORV-0032 projects that exporters should expect delays and should not assume a quick return to normal working, highlighting the ongoing exposure to supply chain disruptions.
